eyebrow.zh: 正向文风 · 跨篇一致 · 本地可跑

headline.zh:
给公众号长文装上一种
可命名的中文文体
headline.en:
Give your long-form writing
a nameable Chinese voice

sub.zh: 三联生活周刊体这样的编辑视角，做成可安装的 Skill——连载到第 5 篇，不用再每篇手动 re-voice。
sub.en: Editorial voices like 三联体 as an installable Skill — your serial stays in one voice past essay #5.

title.zh: 装上一种命名文体，不是只去掉 AI 味
title.en: Adopt a named voice, don't just strip AI slop

body.zh: 别人的工具只把 AI 味洗掉，停在“不坏但也不是什么”。Wenti 给你正向装上一种可命名的编辑视角——三联体 pack 是 hand-curated 的文风本身。
body.en: Other tools only wash out AI-slop, stopping at “not bad but not anything”. Wenti positively installs a nameable editorial voice — the 三联体 pack IS the hand-curated style.

title.zh: 连载第 5 篇，还在同一种文体
title.en: Stay in one voice past essay #5

body.zh: 草稿写到第 5 篇想统一回三联体视角，今天得每篇手动 re-voice。一条命令固定文体，agent 跨篇保持同一种命名文风。
body.en: Want essay #5 back in 三联体 voice? Today you re-voice each one by hand. One command fixes the voice; your agent keeps the same named style across the serial.

title.zh: 量出 bare 到文体的差距
title.en: See the gap from bare to styled

body.zh: 同一篇草稿，bare 模型输出和文体 pack 输出各打一次分——句式 / 用词 / 节奏 / 视角，差距看得见：1.12 → 3.82。
body.en: Score the same draft twice — bare model output vs styled pack output — on structure / diction / rhythm / angle. The gap is visible: 1.12 → 3.82.

chips: › 句式 / 用词 / 节奏 / 视角

title.zh: 离线先自检，不调模型也能跑
title.en: Self-check offline, runs without a model key

body.zh: 没有 API key 也能先跑——本地启发式打分，开箱即用。配好 key 再切到模型打分，同一套报告。
body.en: No API key? Run the local heuristic scorer out of the box. Add a key to switch to model scoring — same report.

headline.zh: 先给你的下一篇装上文体
headline.en: Give your next essay a voice
